Permissions this app asks for
Send SMS (required)
Forwards each member\'s message to the rest of the group and replies to commands.
Receive SMS (required)
Lets the relay get the texts members send to this number.
Read SMS and receive MMS
Picks up replies members post in group (MMS) threads.
Notifications
Shows the relay\'s status and warns you about problems. Asked on Android 13 and later.
Android asks for each one after you select I Agree. You can change them later in Android settings.
